age_bands.complexity: very simple outlines, a few large enclosed coloring areas, few objects, minimal background detail.
simple clear outlines, large enclosed coloring areas, several objects, light background detail.
moderately detailed outlines, varied medium coloring areas, several objects and a detailed background.

composition_views.front: front view, subject facing the viewer
composition_views.wide: wide view, smaller subject within its surroundings

standard_provider_prefix: Create a printable coloring page with bold clean black outlines on a pure white background, enclosed areas to color, and generous white margins. Follow any complexity guidance in the subject description. No shading, gray, colors, text, or watermarks. Friendly, gentle, child-appropriate imagery only. Subject and complexity guidance:
standard_negative_prompt: color, shading, grayscale, gradients, shadows, photographs, text, letters, watermarks
provider_note: This is a snapshot of the standard app guidance, not an API request. Provider-specific adapters may use different wrappers and parameters; record the effective prompt and the negative prompt actually sent for each image.
